results.title: Freshworks CRM Pricing – is it worth the cost?
results.content:
Freshsales CRM (part of Freshworks) offers a range of plans designed to help businesses streamline their sales processes. With features like AI-driven insights, contact management, and automation, Freshsales is a strong contender for sales-focused teams. However, its pricing structure, especially for larger teams, makes it essential to evaluate its value compared to alternatives like Capsule CRM.

### Freshsales pricing plans

 Growth Plan – $11/user/month (billed monthly) [...] You should ensure the CRM’s entry-level plans provide sufficient features for your operations. As your needs grow, you can upgrade to higher plans.

 Freshsales CRM: Free and Growth plans lack advanced analytics and automation, often pushing users to upgrade to higher-cost tiers
 Capsule CRM: Includes essential features such as task management, custom pipelines, and third-party integrations across all paid plans, minimizing the need for frequent upgrades. [...] ## FAQs

Freshsales CRM pricing starts at $0 for its free plan and goes up to $69 per user/month (billed annually) for the Enterprise Plan.

Freshsales CRM’s lower tiers lack advanced features like custom workflows and analytics, while higher-tier plans and add-ons can be expensive.

Freshsales CRM is ideal for small-to-medium sales and marketing teams looking for AI-driven insights and sales pipeline management tools.
